evidence_refs: Famine-era migration opens the narrative; husband death, sons marriages and deaths, and Naomi left bereaved form a completed nadir before fresh return action at 1:6.
Naomi arises to return at 1:6; repeated return language binds dismissal, Orpah departure, Ruth pledge, acceptance, arrival, Mara speech, and barley-harvest summary through 1:22.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Ruth.1.6-1.18 / 1.19-1.22 as road decision versus arrival/lament; retain the return inclusio and Bethlehem outcome in the larger LOW unit.

evidence_refs: Boaz is introduced and Ruth initiates gleaning; encounter, protection, refuge blessing, meal, commands, yield, Naomi report, goel recognition, and harvest-duration summary close at 2:23.

challenges.claim: Preserve Ruth.2.1-2.16 / 2.17-2.23 as field encounter versus result/home report; retain the report because it interprets Boaz and closes the harvest interval.

evidence_refs: Naomi proposes rest; repeated do-all-you-say/did-all-commanded/reported-all-done links plan, execution, petition, promise, gift, return, and same-day forecast through 3:18.

challenges.claim: Preserve Ruth.3.1-3.5 / 3.6-3.15 / 3.16-3.18 as plan, execution, and report; retain the causal chain while euphemism, wing/skirt, and goel force remain unresolved.

evidence_refs: Gate relocation convenes nearer redeemer and elders; offer, 4:5 condition, refusal, sandal, acquisition, witnesses, blessings, marriage, birth, women response, naming, and David notice close the prose plot at 4:17.

challenges.claim: Preserve Ruth.4.1-4.12 / 4.13-4.17 as gate procedure versus marriage/birth outcome; retain claim and narrated fulfillment together while 4:5 and legal/social custom remain unresolved.

evidence_refs: The generations-of-Perez formula changes form; repeated became-father-of sequence closes as a complete register at David.
